profile.aboutHtml:
I'm Abdelrahman Eslam Omar, a Computer & Data Science student at Alexandria University with a strong interest in AI research and intelligent systems.

I enjoy building AI agents, LLM applications, and RAG systems, while exploring how models, tools, memory, and retrieval can work together to create reliable AI systems.
